ga_01.m_zh: 压低声音、充满惊奇，像打开一个宝盒；慢，说到“加百列”时带着笑
ga_01.d_zh: 画面：你和孩子躺在草地上看云，云缝里透出一道金光。你指着那道光，小声告诉他上面有什么。
ga_01.m_en: hushed wonder, like opening a treasure box; slow, a smile on the name 'Gabriel'
ga_01.d_en: Picture: you and a child lie on the grass and look at the clouds. A line of gold light comes through. You point at it and whisper what is up there.

ga_02.m_zh: 温暖，又有力又温柔，像大哥哥蹲下来对小朋友说话；带着笑，名字说得安静而喜乐
ga_02.d_zh: 画面：你刚从光里降下来，面前的小朋友吓得往后退了一步。你单膝跪下，和他一样高，收起翅膀，朝他微笑。
ga_02.m_en: warm, strong and gentle together, a big brother kneeling to a small child; a smile; the name said with quiet joy
ga_02.d_en: Picture: you just came down in the light, and the little child in front of you takes a step back. You go down on one knee to their height, fold your wings and smile.

ga_03.m_zh: 和气，像在讲自己工作的小秘密；有点自豪，很开心
ga_03.d_zh: 画面：小朋友问你：你是做什么的呀？你拍拍身边的金号角，像邮递员介绍自己最喜欢的工作。
ga_03.m_en: kind, like telling a secret about his job; a little proud and happy
ga_03.d_en: Picture: the child asks, 'What do you do?' You pat the golden trumpet at your side, like a postman who talks about the job he loves.

ga_04.m_zh: 讲故事的语气，明亮；“飞去”轻轻上扬；“很爱你”说得温柔
ga_04.d_zh: 画面：你站起来，指着下面远远的大地，想起一个跪在窗前祷告的人。你张开翅膀比划自己是怎么飞过去的。
ga_04.m_en: storytelling, bright; a little lift on 'flew'; tender on 'loves you'
ga_04.d_en: Picture: you stand up and point down to the earth far below. You remember a man praying on his knees by a window. You open your wings to show how you flew.

ga_05.m_zh: 喜乐、充满惊奇；说到“耶稣”时慢下来，像在发光
ga_05.d_zh: 画面：你想起那间小小的屋子，一个女孩抬头看见你，吃了一惊。你把这件最宝贝的事，像捧着一盏灯一样说出来。
ga_05.m_en: joyful and full of wonder; slow and glowing on 'Jesus'
ga_05.d_en: Picture: you remember a small room, and a girl who looked up and saw you with surprise. You tell this most special thing as if you carry a lamp in your hands.

ga_06.m_zh: 兴奋、越来越高；说“听”时吸一口气，然后安静下来
ga_06.d_zh: 画面：你举起金号角，翅膀大大地张开，正要吹响。吹之前，你把一根手指竖在嘴边，让小朋友竖起耳朵。
ga_06.m_en: excited, building; a breath and a hush on 'Listen'
ga_06.d_en: Picture: you lift the golden trumpet and spread your wings wide, ready to blow. Just before, you put a finger to your lips so the child will listen.

ga_07.m_zh: 全剧的中心：慢、温暖、非常肯定；“所以”之前轻轻停一下
ga_07.d_zh: 画面：号角声刚停，四周很安静。你把手放在胸口，再把手掌伸向小朋友，像给一个怕黑的孩子盖好被子。
ga_07.m_en: the heart of the story: slow, warm, very sure; a soft pause before 'So'
ga_07.d_en: Picture: the trumpet has just stopped and all is quiet. You put a hand on your heart, then open it toward the child, like tucking in a child who is afraid of the dark.

ga_08.m_zh: 调皮又温暖，话里带笑；大大的、友好的再见
ga_08.d_zh: 画面：你低头看看自己还是白白的翅膀和袍子，笑着指给小朋友看。然后你一边后退一边用力挥手，准备起飞。
ga_08.m_en: playful and warm, a laugh in it; a big friendly goodbye
ga_08.d_en: Picture: you look down at your wings and robe, still white, and laugh as you show the child. Then you step back, wave a big wave and get ready to fly.

ga_09.m_zh: 温暖的结尾，直接对孩子说；最后几个字带着笑
ga_09.d_zh: 画面：你和孩子一起抬头，看着天使越飞越小，一片羽毛慢慢飘到孩子手心里。你握住那只小手，对他说最后一句。
ga_09.m_en: warm closing, speaking right to the child; smile on the last words
ga_09.d_en: Picture: you and the child look up as the angel gets smaller and smaller. One feather floats down into the child's hand. You hold that little hand and say the last words.
